title: Written Notice of Cancellation: Added Credit under the Student Transportation Services Refund Schedule
content:
Written notice adds credit when a family cancels its Student Transportation Services courtesy rider permit. The notice read is the latest permit cancellation request on the assignment that stands as received (the latest by the time it was received).

| That request was received, counted back from the last day of service | Months added |
|---|---|
| 14 or more calendar days before | one month (1) |
| 7 to 13 calendar days before | half a month (0.5) |
| fewer than 7 calendar days before, or no received permit cancellation request on the assignment | nothing |

Each month added is added to the credited share at one month's share of the months the fee covers, one divided by them, and nothing for a fee that covers no months. The months the fee covers are all the months of the permit period for a fee posted before its first school day; for a school-year fee posted on or after that day, the whole calendar months from the posting month through May, that month included; for any other fee posted on or after that day, the calendar days from the posting day to the period's last day, divided by the calendar days from the period's first school day to its last day, times the months of the period.

## Both sides (hypothetical last day of service, March 20)

| Request received | Calendar days before | Months added |
|---|---|---|
| March 6 | 14 | 1 |
| March 7 | 13 | 0.5 |
| March 13 | 7 | 0.5 |
| March 14 | 6 | nothing |

On a school-year fee covering 10 months, one month adds 0.10 to the credited share and half a month adds 0.05.
